title: Gravity Adapter Params
description: A schema which validates params accepted by the Gravity adapter

userId.description: Stable per-user identifier for frequency capping and attribution

sessionId.description: Session identifier for frequency capping and experiment bucketing

messages.description: Recent conversation history for contextual ad matching

placementId.description: Unique slot name within the publisher's UI (e.g. chat-main)

excludedTopics.description: Topics to exclude from ad matching (e.g. ["politics"])

hashedPhone.description: SHA-256 hashed phone number (digits only before hashing)
